description: This file defines a Kotlin class NotificationsStore that provides local persistence for notification data using SharedPreferences and JSON serialization via Moshi. It includes methods to load and save a list of NotificationItem objects, facilitating app data persistence without a database like Room.

classes.name: NotificationsStore
classes.description: A class providing local storage for notification objects using SharedPreferences and Moshi JSON serialization.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of NotificationItem objects from SharedPreferences, returns empty list on missing or corrupt data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves a list of NotificationItem objects to SharedPreferences.
